name: obsidian-organize-marketplace
description: Personal-knowledge-management plugins for Obsidian vaults. Ships the obsidian-organize plugin with three skills: research (gather source material), add_wiki (promote to topic note), remove_wiki (retire topic + archive). Additive over hermes-wiki-super's add-wiki / process-clippings.

plugins.name: obsidian-organize
plugins.description: Topic-organizer for Obsidian vaults. Exposes research, add_wiki, and remove_wiki skills that operate on a local vault. Inherits frontmatter + tag conventions from hermes-wiki-super's add-wiki and process-clippings skills. Skill IDs follow the namespace:skill convention: obsidian-organize:research, obsidian-organize:add_wiki, obsidian-organize:remove_wiki.
